in_marathi.name: Monoranjan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who delights in the moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Monoranjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Monoranjan is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Mono’ meaning one and ‘Ranjan’ meaning delighting or pleasing. This name is associated with the moon and is believed to bring joy and happiness.
